label: PREBUILT TEST DOUBLES, UNCERTIFIED, NOT A REPRODUCIBLE BUILD
statement: These are test doubles for external protocols, used only by make quick so the sandbox story runs without Rust. They were built with the repository's normal non-reproducible build, so a rebuild on another host or toolchain install may produce different bytes; their hashes pin these exact bytes, not a build recipe. make test and make demo build the stubs from source and are the certified path. The mandate make quick deploys is the reproducible deployment candidate fixtures/deploy/bounded_mandate-163ccfa-reproducible.wasm, not a file in this directory.

mock_ft.wasm.role: Test double NEP-141 token; deployed twice as the USDC and wNEAR test tokens

mock_oracle.wasm.role: Test double of aggregate-oracle.near: operator-set prices; never oracle output

mock_mpc.wasm.role: Test double of the MPC signer v1.signer: signs with deterministic Ed25519 TEST keys anyone can recompute; never MPC output
